title: My Stepson Sold My Clock Collection For $710K, Left Me With $4K. So I Dressed Him In Shame Vest.
description: After my stepson tricked me out of my late husband's clock collection, I found an old notarized agreement hidden in a pendulum case. That paper voided his $710K sale, sent him to federal prison, and now he dusts dials in my shop wearing a vest that says 'Wound Up in Lies.' Every repair tag prints his fraud docket number. #ClockRevenge #TockOfBetrayal #WoundUpInLies
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY CLOCKS, NOW HE WEARS A SHAME VEST
pinned_comment: If your stepson forged a dissolution and sold your late husband's $710K clock collection, leaving you with a $4K check, would you have dressed him in a vest that says 'Wound Up in Lies' too? Share your story in the comments.
